experiment_data.hypothesis: Floor ratio ablation: raising the MLP floor from 0.4 to 0.5 constrains pruning to be more conservative. If floor=0.5 improves GSM8K accuracy over floor=0.4, it suggests CKA-only criterion benefits from a higher minimum layer size. Maps the sensitivity curve of floor parameter on recovery quality.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 bash scripts/run_floor_ablation.sh 0.5 3"
